scenicChapters.title: Pyrenees N260 Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 41 km this is Pyrenees N260 Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-northern-battery-no-3-the-ensembl.story: A 154 km round trip from Kronstadt - roughly 2 h 39 in the saddle. On the way it passes The Palace and Park of the Znamenskaya Dat, Volkhonskoe Highway, The Ensemble of the Zinoviev's Datcha and back through Volkhonskoe Highway. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
